exposure: Patients presenting after normal vaginal delivery
Patients with a history of curettage
outcome: Treatment efficacy of UAE for symptomatic post-pregnancy AVMs
Time to resumption of normal menstrual cycle
cohort: 15 patients presenting with abnormal uterine bleeding following pregnancy, suspected to have an arteriovenous malformation (AVM) confirmed by angiography
finding: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) is an effective treatment modality for the management of symptomatic post-pregnancy AVMs.
